scheme_name: Workers In Case Of Permanent Disablement-JKBOCWWB
other_conditions: Must have worked in building or other construction for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months
Must be a registered member of the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
benefits_summary: Provides a lump sum of ₹2,00,000 to registered BOC workers in case of permanent disablement.
